modmenu.descriptionTranslation.real-time: Real-time CraftingTable: a real-time 3D preview of your crafting result above the workbench, with smooth animations and lots of customization.
rtct.config.title: Real-time CraftingTable Config
rtct.config.enable.name: Enable Mod
rtct.config.floatingType.name: Floating Type
rtct.config.visualStyle.name: Visual Style
rtct.config.visualStyle.tooltip: Floating: materials hover above the tabletop. Flat: materials lie flat on the tabletop; the result always floats.
rtct.config.facing.name: Facing Mode
rtct.config.facing.tooltip:
Fixed: synced for all players, everyone faces the player who last opened the workbench; switches only when opened.
Follow Player: client-side only, the panel follows your own live rotation.
rtct.config.facingAnim.name: Facing Transition Time
rtct.config.keep.name: Keep Items When Closed
rtct.config.keep.tooltip: When enabled, closing the workbench screen keeps the crafting materials at the table so you can view/edit them next time you open it.
rtct.config.growth.name: Growth Animation
rtct.config.growth.tooltip: Pop-in animation scaling materials/results from zero to full size when they appear.
rtct.config.growthTime.name: Growth Duration
rtct.config.renderDist.name: Preview Render Distance
rtct.config.renderDist.tooltip:
Workbench previews beyond this distance are not rendered.
0 = Unlimited.
rtct.config.floatHeight.name: Item Float Height
rtct.config.itemSize.name: Item Size
rtct.config.slotSpacing.name: Slot Spacing
rtct.config.floatSpeed.name: Item Float Speed
rtct.config.floatAmp.name: Item Float Amplitude
rtct.config.resultSize.name: Result Size
rtct.config.rotateSpeed.name: Result Rotation Speed
rtct.config.resultHeight.name: Result Height
rtct.config.resultFloatSpeed.name: Result Float Speed
rtct.config.resultFloatAmp.name: Result Float Amplitude
